author: jakobmcwhinney.bsky.social
text: During an investigation of an officer suspected of having a sexual relationship with a domestic violence victim, SDPD used Flock to track the movements of both the officer and the victim. The incident's sparked pushback from officers and anti-Flock activists angling to get the tech out of San Diego.
